current_runtime_flow_observed: dialogue_manager.plan_dialogue_action currently builds contextual_buyer_semantics and dialogue_pragmatics before choosing continuity
plan_dialogue_action then prioritizes terminal call control, rejected ASR quality gate, contextual semantics, pragmatics, and live_voice_session_policy fallback
generic campaign entrypoint applies guarded response generation, anti-loop repair, duplicate repair, conversation memory, stability guard, decision override, and TTS attachment
browser demo path selects RouteSignal or generic config before calling the same RouteSignal/generic turn builders
integration_sequence: Browser/server receives transcript and selected campaign mode.
Universal ASR repair check runs before buyer-move routing.
Existing contextual buyer semantics extracts buyer meaning and campaign gap evidence.
Universal policy maps buyer move plus conversation stage to response-shape constraints.
Dialogue manager chooses action while obeying universal call-control and response-shape constraints.
Existing live voice session policy renders text but must obey the selected response shape.
Existing duplicate, anti-loop, and stability guards remain safety nets.

recommended_first_integration_slice.slice: generic-campaign universal ASR garble boundary with policy-frame trace
recommended_first_integration_slice.why: It is the smallest behavior-changing slice that addresses observed ASR nonsense before semantic routing, prevents false pain or appointment capture, and leaves RouteSignal/default live-demo behavior untouched.
not_first: Full product-detail universal handling is broader and touches regulated wording.
Full repeated diagnostic prevention crosses response rendering and stability guard behavior.
Full why/contradiction repair requires more semantic/pragmatic mapping and has higher RouteSignal regression risk.

feature_gating.recommended_mode: trace all policy frames, enforce first slice only for generic campaigns
feature_gating.rollback: Disable universal_policy_enforcement while keeping policy_frame trace for diagnosis.

scenarios: RouteSignal default still works: __agent_open__, yeah sure, callbacks are fine.
Generic insurance ASR garble: __agent_open__, yeah sure, play a double be good.
Generic automotive near-miss: __agent_open__, yes, repeal timings are usually pretty long.
Generic automotive clean pain: __agent_open__, yes, repair timings are usually pretty long.
Generic challenge: __agent_open__, yes, repair timings are usually pretty long, why are you asking for this information again.
Generic product-detail: __agent_open__, yes, what does your product do?
Generic appointment confirmation garble after callback time ask: yadav would be good.

risks: A policy layer can become a second dialogue manager if it starts emitting final prose or choosing actions directly.
ASR near-miss mapping can overcorrect valid buyer language if the first slice does more than ask for confirmation.
RouteSignal regressions are likely if universal enforcement is enabled there before generic fixtures prove stable.
Repeated-menu prevention may conflict with existing stability guards unless the policy frame is recorded before the guards run.
recommended_next_phase: 4E2B: add UniversalConversationPolicyFrame trace and enforce generic-only ASR garble repair before contextual semantics, with RouteSignal enforcement disabled.
